Join us as we explore the latest insights, trends, and statistics shaping the supply chain and logistics world. Hosted by industry experts, each episode features discussions with guest speakers, offering a closer look at key topics impacting today's industry.

Join us as we dive into new consumer expectations, the rising cost of delivery mistakes, and why shipping protection, visibility, and personalization are not only critical to winning the holiday season, but also keeping your customers into the new year.

Dive deeper into logistics and shipping protection with our industry insights and whitepapers. These resources will help you reduce risks, protect your brand, and deliver a better customer experience.
What Apparel Brands Get Wrong About Post-Purchase Risk
InsureShield® shipping insurance puts an end to JCR Distributors’ declared-value claims battle.
Why Lost Packages Are Part of the Problem
Stay updated on the latest logistics news, industry insights, and company updates. Join our social media community and never miss a tip, trend, or resource that could benefit your business.

This information does not in any way alter or amend the terms, limitations or exclusions of the applicable insurance policy or program. Insurance coverage is not available in all jurisdictions.

Unless otherwise noted, all statistics used herein are derived from or based on information contained in the 2023 Platform Research, which is based on a compilation of two independent studies conducted by Evalueserve in December 2023 of 1,245 U.S. SMB owners and decision makers whose businesses report $250K - $100M in revenue.

Statistics in our social media advertising are based on aggregated insurance product data collected by UPS Capital Insurance Agency, Inc. during the period of four consecutive fiscal quarters ending the prior calendar year. Individual results may vary.
